purpose: advance CEUNIA from protocol discovery to governed admission of an external MCP server
state_of_art_signal: Current MCP work is moving beyond interoperability toward runtime reliability and trust/admission controls. MCP itself standardizes interaction but does not by itself establish that an external server is trusted or that every exposed tool is in scope.

gate.F: classify tool risk and required permissions

epistemic_boundary: Official documentation establishes how Serena and MCP can operate; it does not establish that a live Serena instance is connected to this runtime.
security_principle: Interoperability is capability. Admission is governance. Execution requires both.
next_required: Expose a live Serena MCP transport, execute discovery, verify identity/capabilities/protocol, create a deny-by-default tool allowlist, then permit a read-only tool call if authorized.
